sentences.text: The Retail Loan Policy allows the bank, at the time of reset of a floating rate, to offer the borrower a choice to switch to a fixed rate as per its Board-approved policy.

That option is consistent with the current RBI rule for UCBs, which also permits a UCB, at its option, to provide a choice to switch over to a fixed rate at the time of reset of interest rates as per its Board-approved policy.
The earlier RBI circular on reset of floating interest rate on EMI-based personal loans was withdrawn and was no longer in force on the as-of date.
